data.standardized_narrative: In 2016, Syndicate 6117 reported an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves, primarily due to better than expected claims experience in the property reinsurance class of business. Gross prior year development, derived from the claims development table for the 2014 underwriting year, showed a release of GBP 0.269 million.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is derived from the gross claims development table for the 2014 underwriting year, as only this year qualifies as 'prior year' under the exclusion rule for the two most recent underwriting years. A net prior year reserve surplus of GBP 1.8m is mentioned in the narrative, but the gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
